Use null for unknown coordinates. For a base quantity known not to participate, explicitly return '0'; this is known absence, not uncertainty. Use null only when the exponent is genuinely unknown. Never infer unknown as0. Exclude the output and metadata/unused/derived columns. quantity_name and physical_definition are retrieval meaning fields: do not put assigned SI units, dimension vectors or exponent formulas there. Do not output a separate dimensional matrix or n/r/k. They are generated deterministically from this ledger. A confident name is not proof of its SI vector.
